question: What offerings and bodily gesture accompany reverent bowing to the lord?
premises: Fragrances, flowers and similar items are used as offerings.
Incenses are also presented as offerings.
Bowing is performed with the head to the lord.
inference: Reverence to the lord involves offering fragrances, flowers and incense while bowing with the head.
plain_english: Having bowed with the head to the lord, one should offer fragrances, flowers and other such things, along with incenses.
